items.title: Parker Washington: Unlikely to sign extension soon
items.description:
Washington is unlikely to agree to a contract extension with Jacksonville before the start of the season, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Contract extension talks on hold
items.description:
Jackson and the Ravens aren't expected to agree on a contract extension before 2027, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Extension talks paused
items.description:
Stroud and the Texans will wait until after the 2026 season to work out a long-term contract extension, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cooper Rush: Will start Week 1 despite back spasms
items.description:
Rush (back) experienced back spasms Saturday but still will start Sunday's game at Pittsburgh, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Fades injury tag Week 1
items.description:
Mahomes (knee) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Broncos.
